guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step where it runs 'apt-get update && apt-get install' due to multiple 404 Not Found errors when accessing debian-security package URLs. This indicates that the Debian Bullseye security repository packages have moved or are no longer available at those URLs, causing apt-get to fail. The root cause is that Debian Bullseye (Debian 11) is in security LTS and the mirror URLs for the security fixes may have changed or been archived. To fix this, update the Debian repository URLs in the Dockerfile to valid mirrors. Specifically, consider replacing the debian-security URLs with the archive.debian.org equivalents or updating the image base to another Debian version (e.g., bullseye-updates or stable or testing) that has supported package locations. Another approach is to add 'apt-get update --fix-missing' or adjust the sources.list before installing. The important part is to ensure that apt-get can successfully fetch all required packages without 404 errors. Without fixing this, the Dockerfile environment setup will not complete, thus no tests can be run.
